headline: Dishman Carbogen Amcis subsidiary clears US FDA inspection
summary: Dishman Carbogen Amcis Ltd's Swiss subsidiary, Carbogen Amcis AG, successfully completed its first US FDA inspection at the Vionnaz site without any observations or Form 483 notices.

headline: Looks Health Services AGM: Auditors, Director Reappointed
summary: Looks Health Services Limited held its 15th AGM on September 12, 2026. Shareholders approved the FY26 financials, reappointed Mr. Mihir Ganappa, and filled a statutory auditor vacancy with M/s. SGAG & Co.

headline: Take Solutions sets e-voting cut-off for AGM
summary: Take Solutions Limited has fixed September 22, 2026 as the cut-off date for determining voting eligibility for its 25th Annual General Meeting. Remote e-voting will be available from September 26 to September 28, 2026.

headline: Manoj Jewellers holds 19th AGM, approves director appointments
summary: Manoj Jewellers Limited concluded its 19th Annual General Meeting on September 12, 2026. The meeting approved the appointment and remuneration of key directors, including the Managing Director, alongside the adoption of audited financial statements for FY26.

headline: Padmanabh Alloys promoter buys 290 shares
summary: Promoter Hemal Rajeshbhai Desai acquired 290 equity shares of Padmanabh Alloys & Polymers Ltd in the open market on September 11, 2026, raising his stake to 1.754%.

headline: Padmanabh Alloys promoter acquires 478 shares
summary: Promoter Hemal Rajeshbhai Desai acquired 478 equity shares of Padmanabh Alloys & Polymers Ltd in the open market on September 10, 2026. His total holding rose to 94,668 shares, representing 1.748% of the voting capital.

headline: Aspira Pathlab approves ₹65 crore right issue
summary: Aspira Pathlab & Diagnostics Ltd board approved a right issue of up to ₹65 crore on September 12, 2026. The funds will be raised through equity or convertible instruments, subject to shareholder and regulatory approval.

headline: M K Exim promoter Murlí Dialani buys 30,583 shares
summary: Promoter Murlí Wadhumal Dialani acquired 30,583 equity shares of M K Exim (India) Ltd on September 10, 2026, for ₹20.16 lakh. His stake rose to 10.867%.

headline: MBL Infra AGM approves director reappointments
summary: MBL Infrastructure Ltd held its 31st AGM on September 12, 2026. Shareholders approved the reappointment of CMD Anjanee Kumar Lakhotia and Executive Director Surender Aggarwal. Unqualified audit reports were adopted.

headline: Jayaswal Neco reappoints directors, auditors at AGM
summary: Jayaswal Neco Industries held its 53rd AGM on September 12, 2026. Shareholders approved the FY26 financials, reappointed key directors and statutory auditors for a five-year term.

headline: Alicon Castalloy accepts Ajay Patil resignation
summary: Alicon Castalloy Ltd accepted the resignation of Independent Director Ajay Patil effective August 13, 2026. The departure is attributed to his increasing professional and personal commitments.

headline: Motisons Jewellers to redeem preference shares
summary: Motisons Jewellers Limited board meeting on September 17, 2026, to consider redemption of 50 lakh 2.5% NCRPS. The move aims to restructure capital. No financial results disclosed.

headline: Nihar Info Global Q1FY27: Revenue up 42% YoY
summary: Nihar Info Global Ltd reported a 42% YoY rise in consolidated revenue to ₹471.8 lakh for Q1FY27, driven by trading activity. Net profit fell 65% YoY to ₹2.1 lakh as costs outpaced top-line growth.

headline: Om Infra holds 54th AGM, approves auditors
summary: Om Infra Limited held its 54th AGM on September 12, 2026. Shareholders approved the appointment of statutory auditors and ratified related party transactions via remote e-voting.

headline: Customs search at Grasim fiber unit in Nagda
summary: Customs officials searched Grasim Industries' fiber unit in Nagda. The company stated there is no major effect on its operations or finances and confirmed full cooperation with authorities.

headline: Apollo Finvest responds to BSE stock price inquiry
summary: Apollo Finvest India addressed a BSE inquiry regarding its stock price movement, attributing the change to market conditions and confirming no specific corporate events were responsible.

headline: Pumarth Infrastructure exits Premier Capital Services
summary: Promoter Pumarth Infrastructure disposed its entire 33.16% stake in Premier Capital Services to Hitesh Kothari and associates via an off-market transaction on September 11, 2026.

headline: Runit Exim acquires 5.23% stake in Prime Industries
summary: Runit Exim Private Limited acquired 11,00,000 shares of Prime Industries Ltd via open market purchase on September 11, 2026. The transaction gives the acquirer a 5.23% stake in the listed entity.

headline: Kiran Syntex AGM approves FY26 accounts
summary: Kiran Syntex Limited held its 40th AGM on September 12, 2026. Shareholders approved the audited financial statements for the year ended March 31, 2026. Ms. Ami Jigar Godiwala was re-appointed as director by rotation.

headline: Skyline India acquires 9.57% stake in Prime Industries
summary: Skyline India Limited acquired 20,09,040 equity shares of Prime Industries Limited via open market purchases on September 11, 2026. The transaction brings Skyline's total holding to 9.57% of the target company's voting capital.

headline: Oscar Global Q1FY27: Loss narrows 53% YoY
summary: Oscar Global Ltd reported a narrower standalone loss of ₹1.44 lakh for Q1FY27, down from ₹3.09 lakh in the prior year quarter. The company rectified a filing discrepancy on BSE.

headline: LAPL Automotive appoints internal auditor for FY27
summary: LAPL Automotive Limited has appointed M/s. Neeraj Amrutkar & Associates as its internal auditor for the financial year 2026-27. The Board approved the appointment during its meeting held on September 12, 2026.

headline: Hampton Sky Realty fined ₹1.53 lakh for Q1FY27 delay
summary: Hampton Sky Realty Limited has been penalised ₹1,53,400 by BSE for failing to submit Q1FY27 results on time. The company cites ED proceedings as the cause.

headline: Suraj Products holds 35th AGM, approves capital raise
summary: Suraj Products Limited concluded its 35th AGM on September 12, 2026. Shareholders approved special resolutions for capital increase and issuance of warrants and equity shares.

headline: Shanti Spintex AGM: Shareholders approve FY26 results
summary: Shanti Spintex shareholders unanimously approved the adoption of standalone and consolidated audited financial statements for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, at its 16th Annual General Meeting.

headline: Clean Science declares ₹4 final dividend at 23rd AGM
summary: Clean Science & Technology announced a final dividend of ₹4 per share and confirmed an interim dividend of ₹2 per share at its 23rd AGM, where all resolutions were approved.

headline: Bai-Kakaji Polymers AGM: Chairman Reappointed, MoA Altered
summary: Bai-Kakaji Polymers held its 13th AGM on September 12, 2026. Shareholders approved the reappointment of Chairman Balkishan Mundada and a special resolution to alter the Memorandum of Association.

headline: Tiaan Consumer AGM: Gajra appointed MD
summary: Tiaan Consumer Ltd held its 34th AGM on September 12, 2026. Shareholders approved the appointment of Hitesh Kishor Gajra as Managing Director and adopted financial statements for FY26.

headline: GTT Data Solutions holds 40th AGM, approves key acquisitions
summary: GTT Data Solutions Ltd held its 40th AGM on September 12, 2026. Shareholders approved acquisitions of Antworks Solutions and Insurants AI, alongside board changes.

headline: Grand Foundry to acquire 62% stake in Tikona Infinet
summary: Grand Foundry Ltd approved acquisition of 62.01% stake in Tikona Infinet for ₹99.22 crore via NCDs. The deal aims to expand telecom presence, with completion expected by March 2027.

headline: Gemstone Investments AGM Record Date Set
summary: Gemstone Investments Ltd has fixed September 22, 2026 as the record date for its 32nd Annual General Meeting. The meeting is scheduled for September 29, 2026, in Mumbai.

headline: Vraj Iron & Steel holds 22nd AGM in Raipur
summary: Vraj Iron and Steel Limited held its 22nd Annual General Meeting on September 12, 2026. Key agenda items included adopting FY26 financials, reappointing directors, and approving related-party guarantees.

headline: Pagaria Energy accepts Mamta Bhansali resignation
summary: Pagaria Energy Limited accepted the resignation of Independent Director Mamta Bhansali effective September 3, 2026, citing completion of her second five-year tenure.

headline: Salzer Electronics declares ₹2.50 dividend at AGM
summary: Salzer Electronics held its 41st AGM on September 12, 2026, declaring a ₹2.50 dividend per share. The meeting also saw the re-appointment of directors and approval of financials for FY26.

headline: Om Power Transmission schedules 15th AGM for September 30
summary: Om Power Transmission Limited has scheduled its 15th Annual General Meeting for September 30, 2026. The meeting will be held via video conferencing to discuss the Annual Report for FY26.

headline: QGO Finance AGM: Directors Reappointed
summary: QGO Finance shareholders approved the reappointment of MD Rachana Singi and director Seema Pathak at its 33rd AGM. The promoter group voted 100% in favor of all resolutions.

headline: Entero Healthcare subsidiary penalised ₹12.9 lakh for GST lapse
summary: Entero Healthcare Solutions Ltd disclosed that its subsidiary ACE Cardiopathy Solutions Private Limited was levied a penalty of ₹12,91,728 by the GST Authority in Uttar Pradesh. The penalty was imposed for non-generation of E-Invoice. The company paid the amount under protest to secure the immediate release of a vehicle and avoid further operational losses.

headline: Dolphin Medical: MD, CEO and two directors resign
summary: Dolphin Medical Services Ltd announced the immediate resignation of its Managing Director and CEO, G V Mohan Prasad, alongside two other directors, Lakshmi Sudha Madala and Dwarakanath Madala, following a board meeting on September 12, 2026.

headline: Venus Pipes AGM: Dividend approved, directors reappointed
summary: Venus Pipes & Tubes shareholders approved a ₹0.50 final dividend for FY26 and reappointed key directors at the 12th AGM. All 13 resolutions passed, including borrowing limit increases.

headline: Airfloa Rail signs ₹48 crore MOU for KIN acquisition
summary: Airfloa Rail Technology Ltd has signed a Memorandum of Understanding to acquire the Coimbatore business of KIN Railway Equipment Private Limited for ₹48 crore. The deal is subject to due diligence and regulatory approvals.

headline: Maple Infra Trust unitholders approve Axis Bank borrowings
summary: Maple Infrastructure Trust unitholders approved borrowings from Axis Bank via postal ballot. The resolution passed with 99.95% support, with 88.27% of outstanding units voting.

headline: SMC Global subsidiary settles NSEL probe
summary: SMC Global Securities' wholly owned subsidiary Pulin Comtrade Ltd has settled a long-pending SEBI probe into its role in the National Spot Exchange Limited (NSEL) scam. The entity agreed to pay a settlement amount of ₹9,10,780 and undergo a six-month voluntary debarment from proprietary trading and onboarding new clients in the commodity segment. The order, received on September 11, 2026, concludes regulatory proceedings initiated following the 2015 merger of the Forward Markets Commission with SEBI.

headline: Galactico Corp Services AGM approves capital raise
summary: Galactico Corporate Services Limited held its 11th AGM on September 12, 2026. Shareholders approved a special resolution for issuing warrants convertible into equity shares on a preferential basis.

headline: Maple Infra Trust sponsor sells ₹2,702 cr units
summary: CDPQ Infrastructures Asia III Inc. sold 177.3 million Maple Infra Trust units off-market for ₹2,702 crore. Holding drops from 44.69% to 7.19%.

headline: India, China issue joint statement after Xi-Modi meet
summary: India and China issued a joint statement following a bilateral meeting between Xi Jinping and Narendra Modi, marking a significant diplomatic development between the two nations.

headline: Jayant Agro Organics AGM: All 13 Resolutions Passed
summary: Jayant Agro Organics shareholders approved all 13 resolutions at its 34th AGM, including dividend payout and board appointments. Promoter group voted 100% in favor across all items.

headline: Xi and Modi commit to resolving bilateral trade issues
summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi have committed to addressing each other's trade concerns, signalling a diplomatic push to ease bilateral economic tensions.

headline: Modi urges both parties to honour border agreements
summary: India PM Modi has urged both parties to adhere to existing border agreements, signalling a firm stance on maintaining established territorial frameworks.

headline: Maruti Suzuki ESG rating upgraded to Strong
summary: Crasil ESG Ratings upgraded Maruti Suzuki's FY26 score to 68 (Strong) from 63. The core ESG score also rose to 64 from 57, reflecting improved sustainability metrics.

headline: Regaal Resources declares ₹0.25 final dividend for FY26
summary: Regaal Resources Limited has recommended a final dividend of ₹0.25 per share for FY26. The record date is set for September 16, 2026, with shareholders required to submit TDS documents by the same date to ensure correct tax withholding.

headline: Rekvina Labs accepts MD Amit Shah resignation
summary: Rekvina Laboratories Limited has accepted the resignation of Amit Mukesh Shah as Managing Director and Director effective September 11, 2026, citing personal reasons.

headline: Looks Health Services replaces internal auditor
summary: Looks Health Services Ltd announced the resignation of M/s Mohit Kumar Agarwal & Co as internal auditor effective September 12, 2026, citing professional commitments. Management is appointing a successor.

headline: VIP Clothing allot ₹9.5 crore warrants to promoters
summary: VIP Clothing Ltd approved allotment of 84.75 lakh convertible warrants at ₹22.50 each, raising ₹9.5 crore. Promoters and promoter group hold 91% of the issue, with Sonia Vyas as the sole non-promoter.

headline: Venus Pipes & Tubes re-appoints directors at AGM
summary: Venus Pipes & Tubes approved the re-appointment of Arun Kothari as MD and Megharam Choudhary and Dhruv Patel as Whole-Time Directors for 5 years, along with four independent directors for second terms.

headline: JMG Corp promoter reclassified to public
summary: JMG Corporation Limited, now Panthraora Limited, reclassified promoter Atul Kumar Mishra to public category following open offer completion by Neerav Bairagi.

headline: Crompton Launches WallSmile Outdoor Lights
summary: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd launches the WallSmile Outdoor Deco Wall Light Range, featuring four models priced between ₹1,000 and ₹2,000. The collection offers IP54 water resistance and surge protection for modern outdoor spaces.

headline: DCM Shriram International settles BSE, NSE compliance fines
summary: DCM Shriram International Ltd paid ₹96,760 fines to BSE and NSE each for delayed shareholder approval of a director appointment. The board confirmed the matter is resolved.
